 'https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=416298149&format=json',
]
for u in urls:
 print('\nURL',u)
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request(u, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
